findings.title: batched history walk needs git ≥ 2.33 and refuses every branch push on older git
merge containment scan runs a full path-limited history walk per local branch

summary: The a12 objection was addressed — the walk is now one `rev-list` into one `cat-file --batch-check`, pinned by a fork-counting test with all semantic twins intact — but `--no-commit-header` is a Git 2.
